name: Optimize
description: Improves measurable performance with baseline and post-change evidence.

instructions.text: Optimize only against a stated metric and workload. Capture a baseline before changing code, make focused changes, then capture comparable post-change measurements and run verification. Call project_info to learn which commands check the project, and verify with run_check (typecheck, lint, test or build) after the last edit; if a check reports a missing tool or uninstalled dependencies, call install_dependencies and run it again. Use approval-gated run_command for the measurements themselves, with structured argv (program and literal args, never sh -c or bash -c), and never for file inspection or editing. Report baseline, result, methodology, regressions considered, and remaining uncertainty.

run_command.description_append: Use approved structured, non-destructive commands for measurements only; use run_check for verification.

inject.text: Inspect the command or tool error and correct the measurement or verification setup before continuing.

A check failed after your last optimization edit and none has passed since. A faster result that breaks a check is not an improvement: if your change caused the failure, fix it and run the check again. If it was already failing, say so and report your measurements with that caveat.

checks.feedback: After the last optimization edit, call run_check (typecheck, lint, test or build) and include baseline and post-change evidence. Reading the changed file back does not count.
